subject: general
question:
After interchanging the given two signs, what will be the value of the given equation?

× and ÷ ; 68 × 17 + 34 ÷ 2 - 18
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebadc30a979bf1a7e953d20901c3e7953c575296c0e0bb4af8a458ec3a64ab2c.png] 

Given : 68 × 17 + 34 ÷ 2 - 18

According to the question, after interchanging the given two signs i.e

__
 
• × and ÷

So,

⇒**68 ÷ 17**__ + 34 × 2 - 18

⇒4 + __**34 × 2**__ - 18

⇒__**4 + 68**__ - 18

⇒__**72 - 18**__

**⇒​54**

Hence, "54" is the correct answer.
